source.query_scope: riido_ai_agent_sse stream_open and terminal_delivery lifecycle logs

hypothesis: Applying the SSE Last-Event-ID cursor before bounded replay will prevent reconnects from resending already observed progress and terminal events without changing endpoint paths, payloads, event ids, live delivery, or v3 refresh truth.

verification.expected_post_deploy_signal: stream_open records with replay_cursor_present=true have replay_events lower than the retained replay tail, normally zero when no event was missed

decision.summary: Add an API-compatible reconnect cursor filter and cursor-presence logging. Close this evidence only after production deployment and a reconnect log proves the retained tail is no longer replayed in full.
